meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Editorial Graphics, Data Visualization & Historical Storytelling Visual Language

purpose: Turn verified knowledge, time, relationships and evidence into readable visual stories without making Dấu Việt feel like a textbook or generic analytics dashboard.
principles: Visual structure clarifies historical relationships; it never fabricates certainty.
Travel/discovery remains the entry layer; historical graphics deepen understanding rather than dominate every surface.
Use the locked Phase 02 palette semantically and restrainedly; gold is emphasis, not default data ink.
Charts and diagrams must remain understandable in monochrome and without motion.
Editorial graphics inherit Phase 03 typography, Phase 04 semantic glyphs, Phase 05 spatial language, Phase 06 motion and Phase 07 provenance.

rules: turning points use editorial emphasis plus labels, not gold alone
confidence never encoded by color alone
avoid decorative symmetry that implies equivalence
use charts only for genuinely quantitative claims
zero baseline for bars unless a justified exception is explicitly signaled
avoid pie/donut when precise comparison matters
map is contextual evidence, not decorative background

certainty_language.verified: solid treatment + explicit verified/source context where needed
certainty_language.disputed: explicit disputed label + competing evidence access
certainty_language.unknown: do not interpolate visually as known

editorial_composition.exit: what changed / why it matters / where to explore next

quantitative_integrity.source: every factual quantitative visualization must resolve to source/provenance
quantitative_integrity.transform: aggregation/normalization/calculation should be reproducible or documented
quantitative_integrity.missing: missing values shown as missing, never zero by default
quantitative_integrity.scale: avoid truncated or dual-axis treatments that materially mislead

accessibility.text_equivalent: important charts/diagrams need concise summary or accessible data alternative
accessibility.keyboard: interactive nodes/points expose keyboard-reachable details where applicable
accessibility.zoom: labels reflow and remain readable; do not shrink below locked typography tokens

responsive.mobile: progressive disclosure, horizontal time navigation only when accessible alternative exists, simplified graph neighborhood
responsive.rule: mobile simplification may reduce simultaneous density but not remove relationships, uncertainty or evidence retrievability
